awesome-ai-companion（Memory & Identity）.name: nocturne_memory
awesome-ai-companion（Memory & Identity）.desc: Rollbackable, visual long-term memory server for MCP agents: graph-like structured memory instead of vector RAG, works across models and sessions, drop-in for OpenClaw. MIT. `Python` · `Self-host` · `infra`.
